title: Evaluation of PHAC’s Community Action Program for Children (CAPC) and Canada Prenatal Nutrition Program (CPNP) - 2015-16 to 2019-20 - Canada.ca
snippet: PHAC plays a long-standing role in supporting the health of young children and pregnant individuals, particularly for segments of the population that are considered to be at risk, as they face health inequities and other barriers to accessing health and social services.
